pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with high angularity in base structure. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients due to focal blur. Patch area is smaller on the lower neck and increases in size toward the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes predominantly show three-way intersections. Pathways maintain consistent pixel thickness across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of the mane visible along the dorsal neck line against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two dark, avian-form silhouettes located on the upper dorsal shoulder and the central lateral flank.
